description: This file defines the TicketService interface, which declares various methods for managing Ticket entities, including saving, listing, deleting, and retrieving tickets based on different criteria.

classes.name: TicketService
classes.description: An interface declaring service-layer operations for Ticket entities.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores a Ticket object; returns true if successful.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all Ticket objects.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Ticket based on its ID; returns true if deletion was successful.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket by its ID.

methods.name: getTicketByTicketid
methods.description: Retrieves a Ticket using its ticketId.

methods.name: getListBasedOnUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Tickets associated with a specific userId.
